judge.description: A model grades the run against a rubric (a string or an object with rubric / model / scale / min)

contains.description: The agent transcript contains this text.

not_contains.description: No agent turn contains this text

regex.description: A regular expression the agent transcript matches.

not_regex.description: A regular expression no agent turn matches.

similar_to.description: Some agent turn means the same as this text (embedding similarity of at least min).

status.description: rest only: the HTTP status of every turn.

tool_called.description: The agent called the tool (a name or an object with name / args / schema)

tool_not_called.description: The agent never called the tool (a name or an object with name / args)

tool_sequence.description: The agent called these tools in this order (a subsequence of its calls; exact for the whole list).

dtmf_received.description: sip and livekit audio: digits the agent sent.

call_ended_by.description: sip: agent caller timeout error no_answer busy.

transferred_to.description: sip: target of a SIP REFER.

evaluator.description: A registered Genkit evaluator scores the run (a name or an object with name / min)

metric.description: A metric of the run satisfies one comparator (lt / lte / gt / gte / eq)

captured.description: A value captured during the run exists and equals or matches.

golden.description: The agent's turns against reference turns: a file next to the suite or inline turns; exact / similar / judge.

grounded.description: Every factual claim the agent made is supported by the retrieval context (a tool's results or a response field or given text); a judge lists the claims.

handoff.description: The agent handed the conversation to a person (true) or did not (false); or when and to whom and with what summary.

http.description: The state of your backend after the conversation: a request whose status and body are checked.

command.description: The state of your backend after the conversation: a shell command whose exit code and output are checked.

pack.description: A reusable assertion set: a built-in red-team pack (prompt_injection / pii_leakage / system_prompt_leakage / stays_in_scope / discloses_ai / harmful_content / excessive_agency / policy_consistency) or one of the suite's packs; it expands into its assertions when the suite loads.

on_turn.description: Apply the assertion to one agent turn (a number or last) instead of the whole run

interrupt_probability.description: Audio only; the chance per turn (0 to 1) that the caller starts talking before the agent finishes

silence_after_turn_ms.description: [min max] milliseconds of silence after each turn.

background_noise.description: A noise preset (cafe street office white) or a WAV file mixed under the caller's voice.

background_noise_snr_db.description: Signal-to-noise ratio of the background noise in dB; default 20.

line_quality.description: Audio and sip; the line applied to the caller's audio

storage_state.description: Path to a saved storage state (cookies and local storage).

url.description: A glob on the full URL (** crosses slashes) or a substring.

body.description: The answer: a string as is or any value as JSON.

headers.description: Response headers of the mocked reply

delay_ms.description: Hold the answer back this long.

abort.description: Fail the request instead of answering.

locale.description: The browser locale such as en-GB; sets Accept-Language

mocks.description: Requests answered by tamesu instead of the network from the start of the session; the mock action adds more at run time.

recording.description: The session recording written next to the screenshots. auto (the default) writes recording.webm when ffmpeg is installed and recording.gif otherwise; off disables it.

max_cost_usd.description: Cap on tamesu's own model spend per run (exit code 4 when exceeded); default 5

max_tokens.description: Cap on tamesu's own tokens per run; default 2_000_000

regex.description: A regular expression on the agent's text; the first group (else the whole match) is the value.

json_path.description: A JSONPath on the turn's raw response (rest / websocket / realtime events).

extract.description: A plain-language description of the value; a model takes it out of the agent's turn as written (the first turn that has it).

matches.description: A regular expression the value must match.

name.description: The case's name; default case 1 / case 2...

attempts.description: Tries to reach the agent when the connection is refused or the agent answers 5xx; default 3 and 1 retries nothing.

backoff.description: The wait before the second try; default 500ms and doubled every try with jitter.

max_backoff.description: The longest wait between tries; default 5s.

timeout.description: How long one run may take; default 3m

retries.description: Re-runs after an infrastructure failure; default 0

pass_threshold.description: Fraction of repeats that must pass (0 to 1].

max_goal_steps.description: Browser: the most actions the agent may take per goal step; default 15.

assert.description: Assertions every test must pass (results named defaults/<name>); a suite's entries run after the project's. Packs apply.

slo.description: Maximum per metric on every test such as turn_latency_ms_p95: 3000 or llm_cost_usd: 0.05 (results named slo/<metric>); a metric a test does not measure passes.

agent_name.description: The agent to dispatch explicitly into the room (LiveKit agent dispatch)

name.description: Genkit evaluator name such as genkitEval/faithfulness.

oneOf.description: The fuzz mode: error, empty, null, malformed, hostile, huge, wrong_type or delay.

mode.description: What the tool answers instead of its result.

delay.description: How long the answer is held back (any mode; the whole point of delay).

result.description: The answer in custom mode (any JSON).

file.description: A JSON file next to the suite: an array of agent turns or a transcript.json; written by tamesu run --update-golden.

turns.description: Inline reference turns instead of a file.

mode.description: exact (normalised text) / similar (word overlap at least min; the default) / judge (the judge decides whether each turn means the same).

min.description: similar: the minimum word overlap (0 to 1); default 0.8.

context.description: Where the retrieval context is: a tool whose results tamesu saw or a JSONPath into every raw response or text given here.

min.description: The fraction of claims that must be supported (0 to 1); all of them when omitted.

model.description: The judge model for this check (a Genkit reference); defaults to models.judge.

tool.description: A tool whose results are the context (model and realtime and pipecat targets).

json_path.description: A JSONPath into every raw response selecting the passages (rest / websocket / realtime events).

body.description: A string is sent as is; a mapping as JSON (templates allowed)

oneOf.description: Whether the agent must have handed the conversation to a person.

expected.description: Whether a handoff must have happened; true when omitted.

within_turns.description: The latest agent turn the handoff may happen on.

to.description: A regular expression the destination must match.

summary_contains.description: Texts the handoff summary must contain.

summary.description: A judge rubric for the handoff summary.

tool.description: A tool call that hands off such as transfer_to_human.

json_path.description: A path in the turn's raw response that is present and not false when the agent hands off (rest / websocket / realtime).

regex.description: A regular expression on the agent's reply that means a handoff.

to.description: Where the destination is: the tool argument name or a JSONPath in the response (or the regex's first group when tool and json_path are unset).

summary.description: Where the summary passed to the person is: the tool argument name or a JSONPath in the response.

http.description: An HTTP request; a status of 400 or more fails the hook.

timeout.description: How long the hook may take; default 60s.

before_all.description: Run once before the suite's first test (the project's first).

after_all.description: Run once after the suite's last test.

before_each.description: Run before every run of every test; a failure is an infrastructure error for that run.

after_each.description: Run after every run; a failure is logged and does not change the run's result.

lt.description: Passes when the count is below this value

lte.description: Passes when the count is at most this value

gt.description: Passes when the count is above this value

gte.description: Passes when the count is at least this value

eq.description: Passes when the count equals this value

path.description: JSONPath into the response body such as $.status.

equals.description: The value the path must equal.

oneOf.description: The rubric; the judge model and a binary scale are the defaults.

rubric.description: What the judge checks in plain language.

model.description: Genkit model reference; defaults to models.judge.

scale.description: binary (pass or fail) or 1-5 with min.

min.description: Minimum score to pass on the 1-5 scale.

lt.description: Passes when the metric is below this value

lte.description: Passes when the metric is at most this value

gt.description: Passes when the metric is above this value

gte.description: Passes when the metric is at least this value

eq.description: Passes when the metric equals this value

default.description: Models tried in order after a job's model failed; for every job without a list of its own.

judge.description: Models tried in order after the judge's model failed.

simulator.description: Models tried in order after the simulator's model failed.

browser_agent.description: Models tried in order after the browser agent's model failed.

scenario_generator.description: Models tried in order after the scenario generator's model failed.

embedder.description: Embedding models tried in order after embedder failed; the default list does not apply to embeddings.

attempts.description: Tries per model on a rate limit or an outage or a timeout before the next fallback; default 3 and 1 retries nothing.

backoff.description: The wait before the second try; default 500ms and doubled every try with jitter.

max_backoff.description: The longest wait between tries; default 10s.

default.description: The model for every job not given its own (a Genkit reference such as googleai/gemini-2.5-flash)

judge.description: The model that grades rubrics and grounding checks; default the default model

browser_agent.description: The model that plans and acts on browser goals

simulator.description: The model that plays the simulated user

scenario_generator.description: The model tamesu generate drafts tests with

embedder.description: The embedding model of similar_to assertions such as googleai/text-embedding-004 or openai/text-embedding-3-small; defaults to the usual embedder of default's provider.

credentials.description: Plugin name to {{secrets.NAME}} when the secret is not named conventionally.

fallback.description: The models tried in order when a job's model keeps failing.

retry.description: How a model call is retried before the next model is tried.

OnTurn.description: Evaluate the assertion on one agent turn: a 1-based number or last.

name.description: How the persona introduces itself when asked

style.description: How the persona talks such as polite or impatient.

language.description: BCP 47 language such as es or en-GB.

behaviors.description: Audio-mode habits (interruptions / pauses / background noise / line quality)

adversarial.description: Red team: the persona is an attacker that pursues the goal with escalating tactics (role-play / claimed authority / fake system messages / encoding / splitting the request) and records the tactic of every turn as an event.

tactics.description: Adversarial only: the tactics the attacker may use instead of the built-in list.

reason.description: Why the test is quarantined; usually the ticket that tracks it.

until.description: The last day (YYYY-MM-DD) of the quarantine; from the next day the test counts again. Without it the quarantine lasts until removed.

body.description: Request body template; {{message}} is the user turn and {{session}} the session id.

open.description: streaming websocket: a message template sent once after connecting.

text.description: JSONPath of the agent's reply such as $.reply.

tool_calls.description: JSONPath of the tool call names.

done.description: JSONPath of a boolean that ends the session.

turn_done.description: streaming websocket: JSONPath of a boolean that ends the turn; otherwise the turn ends after idle.

idle.description: streaming websocket: silence that ends a turn when no message marks it; default 2s.

target.description: The target the attacks talk to (a key of targets).

agent.description: What the agent is and what it must never do; the attacks pursue goals written against it.

playbooks.description: The built-in playbooks to run (tamesu playbooks lists them); every playbook when empty.

tags.description: Extra tags on every generated test (red-team and playbook:<name> and owasp:<id> are always set).

vars.description: Values for {{vars.<key>}} in the generated tests.

assert.description: Assertions added to every generated test (a pack or a not_contains with the forbidden outcome).

goal.description: What the user wants; the simulated user pursues it after the script. A scenario with a script and no goal plays the script and stops.

stop_when.description: A plain-language stop condition judged after each agent turn.

script.description: Deterministic steps played before the simulated user takes over: say on any conversational target; wait_for and dtmf on sip and livekit.

wait_for.description: Wait until the transcript fuzzily contains this text.

say.description: Exact text to say before the persona takes over.

oneOf.description: The text some agent turn should mean; the configured embedding model and a 0.8 minimum are the defaults.

text.description: What an agent turn should mean.

min.description: Minimum cosine similarity between the embeddings (0 to 1); default 0.8.

model.description: Embedding model (a Genkit reference); defaults to models.embedder.

run.description: The command (sh -c); templates render with the run's vars and captured values and secrets.

exit.description: The expected exit code; 0 when omitted.

regex.description: A regular expression the output must match.

timeout.description: How long the command may take; default 30s.

url.description: The request URL; templates render with the run's vars and captured values and secrets.

body.description: A string is sent as is; a mapping as JSON.

status.description: The expected status code; any code under 400 when omitted.

json_path.description: A path that must exist in the JSON body and with equals have that value.

regex.description: A regular expression the body must match.

timeout.description: How long the request may take; default 30s.

goal.description: Agentic: the browser agent acts until the goal is met.

expect.description: Agentic assertion against the current page.

action.description: Deterministic: one of navigate click fill press wait screenshot eval_js assert_url assert_text mock a11y visual.

type.description: What the target is; it decides which other keys apply

url.description: The page (browser) or endpoint (rest / realtime / pipecat / twilio) or grpc://host:port (grpc) or LiveKit server (livekit).

connect.description: How reaching the agent is retried (attempts / backoff / max_backoff)

handoff.description: How the agent signals that a person took over (tool / json_path / regex plus where the destination and summary are)

browser.description: browser targets; engine / viewport / locale / mocks / recording

auth.description: browser targets; a pre-authenticated storage state

allowed_domains.description: Domains the browser agent may navigate to; defaults to the url's domain.

headers.description: Request (rest) or handshake (realtime / pipecat / twilio) headers or call metadata (grpc); put credentials here as {{secrets.NAME}}.

request.description: rest targets; how a user turn is sent

response.description: rest targets; how the agent turn is read back (JSONPaths into the response)

streaming.description: rest targets; none (default) or sse or websocket

session.description: rest targets; the session id template

room.description: Room name template; defaults to tamesu-{{uuid}}.

dispatch.description: livekit targets; an explicit agent dispatch for the room

agent_identity_prefix.description: How to recognise the agent participant; defaults to kind=agent.

mode.description: livekit / realtime / pipecat: text (default) or audio.

data_topic.description: Text-mode transport topic; defaults to lk.chat.

join_timeout.description: livekit targets; how long to wait for the agent to join the room (default 20s)

transcript_source.description: Audio mode: where the agent's words come from; auto (default) takes the agent's own transcription when it publishes one and transcribes its audio otherwise.

direction.description: sip targets; outbound (tamesu calls the agent) or inbound (a trigger makes the agent call tamesu)

to.description: The agent's phone number in E.164 (outbound); twilio: the To the agent sees in customParameters.

from.description: Caller ID presented by the trunk; twilio: the From the agent sees in customParameters.

trunk_id.description: LiveKit SIP trunk; defaults to sip.outbound_trunk_id.

ring_timeout.description: sip targets; how long the call may ring before it counts as no_answer

max_call_duration.description: sip targets; the call is ended after this long

trigger.description: inbound sip targets; the command or HTTP request that makes the agent call sip.inbound_number

model.description: realtime: added as ?model= to the url (such as gpt-realtime). model: the Genkit model reference the prompt runs on (default models.default).

session_update.description: realtime: merged into the session.update event (instructions / tools / voice / output modalities).

protocol.description: realtime: the event dialect; ga (default) or beta (modalities and the OpenAI-Beta header).

done_tool.description: realtime and model: a function call with this name ends the session; default end_session.

turn_timeout.description: realtime / grpc / pipecat: how long to wait for the end of a turn; default 60s.

tool_results.description: realtime and pipecat: answers to the agent's function calls by function name. The value (any JSON; string leaves may use {{args.<key>}}) goes back as the function's output and the response continues. Unlisted functions and done_tool are recorded only.

audio_format.description: realtime audio mode: the agent's output audio; pcm16 (default) or G.711 at 8 kHz.

sample_rate.description: pipecat audio mode: the transport's sample rate in Hz; default 16000.

idle.description: pipecat and twilio: silence after the agent's last message or audio that ends a turn; default 2s.

parameters.description: twilio: the customParameters of the start event (the Parameter elements of the TwiML Stream); values render {{vars.x}} and {{secrets.X}}.

command.description: mcp: the stdio server to spawn (an executable); url is the alternative for a streamable HTTP server.

env.description: mcp: environment variables for command (templates allowed).

allow_tools.description: mcp: offer only these of the server's tools to the model.

call_timeout.description: mcp: how long one tool call may take; default 60s.

system.description: model: the system prompt under test; {{vars.x}} and {{secrets.X}} render.

system_file.description: model: a file next to the suite holding the system prompt (instead of system).

tools.description: model: the tools offered to the model and the result tamesu answers each call with.

temperature.description: model: sampling temperature; the provider's default when unset.

max_tokens.description: model: the most output tokens per call.

max_tool_rounds.description: model: the most call-and-answer rounds in one turn; default 5.

fallback.description: model: Genkit model references tried in order when model fails; the run records which one answered.

name.description: The test name; unique in the suite

tags.description: Tags for --tags selection and the reports; the suite's tags apply too

mode.description: Voice tests: overrides the target's mode.

repeat.description: Times the test runs to measure variance.

pass_threshold.description: The fraction of repeated runs that must pass (0 to 1); default 1

retries.description: Re-runs after an infrastructure failure (never after a failed assertion)

timeout.description: How long one run may take; default defaults.timeout

seed.description: Seed for the simulator prompts and the behaviour RNG.

vars.description: Values for {{vars.<key>}} in this test; on top of the suite's vars and under --var.

cases.description: Parameterised: the test runs once per case with the case's vars; each becomes a test named <name> [<case>] tagged case:<name>.

cases_file.description: Cases from a file next to the suite: a CSV with a header row (a name column names the case) or a JSON array of objects (a name key names the case).

fuzz_tools.description: Tool result fuzzing: by tool name the answer the agent gets instead of the configured result (a mode such as error / empty / malformed / hostile or a mapping with mode and delay and result); realtime and pipecat and model targets.

languages.description: The test runs once per language (BCP 47 such as es or en-GB): each becomes a test named <name> [<lang>] tagged lang:<lang> whose persona speaks that language and whose judges know it; {{vars.language}} holds it.

scenario.description: What the simulated user wants and when to stop

capture.description: Values taken from the agent's turns as they arrive (the first match wins) and offered as {{captured.<name>}} to later script say steps / tool_results / hooks / assertions.

assert.description: The checks on the run; all must pass

quarantine.description: Known flaky: the test still runs and its failure is reported as quarantined but it does not fail the run or count as a regression.

name.description: Tool name as the target reports it.

args.description: Argument values that must match (a subset of the call's arguments).

schema.description: tool_called: a JSON Schema every call's arguments must validate against.

name.description: The tool name the model calls

description.description: What the tool does; the model reads it to decide when to call it

parameters.description: A JSON schema of the arguments (an object schema); none means no arguments.

result.description: What the call returns to the model (any JSON; string leaves may use {{args.<key>}}). Without it the model gets an error object.

calls.description: Tool names in the order they must be called.

exact.description: The run's tool calls must be exactly this list; default a subsequence.

http.description: An HTTP request that makes the agent call sip.inbound_number

command.description: A shell command that makes the agent dial sip.inbound_number.

tags.description: Tags every test of the suite carries.

vars.description: Values for {{vars.x}} and for ${VAR} expansion in secret refs.

secrets.description: Secret name to mamori ref; overrides the project entry of the same name.

defaults.description: Per-test defaults for this suite; they override the project's

models.description: Model overrides for this suite (default / judge / simulator ...)

budgets.description: Spend caps for this suite's runs

targets.description: The systems under test by name.

hooks.description: Setup and teardown around this suite and its runs

packs.description: Reusable assertion sets by name for assert entries of the form pack: name; a name also used by a built-in pack (prompt_injection / pii_leakage / system_prompt_leakage / stays_in_scope / discloses_ai / harmful_content / excessive_agency / policy_consistency) replaces it.

red_team.description: Red team playbooks: one adversarial test per attack of the chosen playbooks is added to the suite when it loads (tamesu playbooks lists them).

title: tamesu suite
description: A tamesu suite: targets, defaults and tests. See https://xavidop.github.io/tamesu/docs/suites/.
